items.title: 誤會一場 潤泰新：「松濤苑」5樓戶坪價實爲254萬元優於上筆成交
items.title_en: A Misunderstanding: Runtaixin Says the 5th‑Floor Unit at Songtao Garden Actually Sold at NT$2.54 million per Ping, Higher Than the Previous Deal
paras: 原依實價登錄資料顯示，豪宅「松濤苑」今年6月以總價4億6180萬元無貸款交易，成交原潤泰新(9945-TW)的5樓戶，連6個車位共258.22坪，換算單價244.33萬元，但潤泰新指出，此一登錄資料因作業疏失，這筆松濤苑實價登錄漏列車位價1820萬元，因此實際成交價爲4.8億元，坪價爲254萬元且優於上筆交易的250萬元。
潤泰新並強調，目前潤泰新地政部門預計於27日將就此一交易的實價登錄資料實價向地政局申請資料更正。
潤泰新指出， 「松濤苑」5樓戶，由客戶向潤泰新買下，連同6個車位共達258.22坪，扣除車位後的實際銷售每坪單價為254萬元，比前一次成交還高。
如潤泰新對「松濤苑」5樓戶交易實價登錄交易申報完成更正，豪宅社區「松濤苑」完工13年以來的最新成交價格站穩250萬元之上。
台北市中正區植物園景觀豪宅「松濤苑」只興建12樓，總戶數僅20 戶，目前屋齡13年多，依實價登錄交易14筆的資料顯示， 2015年8月，「松濤苑」6樓戶曾創下每坪270.6萬元的社區每坪最高成交單價。
paras_en: According to the original real‑price registration data, the luxury residence "Songtao Garden" was reported to have been sold in June of this year for a total price of NT$461.8 million without a loan, involving Runtaixin's (9945‑TW) 5th‑floor unit together with six parking spaces covering a total of 258.22 ping, which would imply a unit price of NT$2.4433 million per ping. Runtaixin, however, pointed out that the registration omitted the value of the parking spaces—NT$18.2 million—due to a clerical error, so the actual transaction price was NT$480 million, yielding a per‑ping price of NT$2.54 million, which is higher than the previous transaction price of NT$2.5 million.
Runtaixin emphasized that its land‑administration department plans to submit a request to the Land Administration Bureau on the 27th to correct the real‑price registration data for this transaction.

Runtaixin explained that the 5th‑floor unit at "Songtao Garden" was purchased by a client from Runtaixin, including six parking spaces for a total of 258.22 ping; after excluding the parking spaces, the actual sale price per ping is NT$2.54 million, which is higher than the previous deal.

If Runtaixin completes the correction of the real‑price registration for the 5th‑floor unit transaction, the latest sale price of the "Songtao Garden" luxury community—now 13 years since completion—will remain above NT$2.5 million per ping.

The "Songtao Garden" luxury residence in Taipei's Zhongzheng District, adjacent to the Botanical Garden, consists of only 12 floors and 20 units in total. The building is a little over 13 years old, and according to 14 recorded transactions, the highest per‑ping price in the community was set in August 2015 when a 6th‑floor unit sold for NT$2.706 million per ping.

items.title: 避險基金大砍科技股是「布局機會」？高盛建議：「有選擇」地配置AI
items.title_en: Hedge Funds Slash Tech Stocks: A “Layout Opportunity”? Goldman Sachs Advises “Selective” AI Allocation
paras: 美股人工智慧（AI）交易近期遭遇新一波賣壓，避險基金加速降低槓桿，科技股持倉也出現大幅調整。高盛認為，市場降溫已為部分AI概念股創造布局機會，但目前仍不宜全面抄底，關鍵在於龍頭企業的獲利預期能否維持，以及龐大的AI資本支出最終能否轉化為足夠的現金流。
根據高盛數據，本週高盛避險基金VIP持股組合週四（22日）創下2011年以來最差單日表現，該行大宗經紀業務的科技股賣出規模，也創2024年9月以來新高。
與此同時，標普500非AI成分股指數今年以來的漲幅首度超越標普500指數整體，顯示過去近3年由AI概念股主導的超額報酬優勢正在減弱。
市場重新評估AI投資的成本與回報，是這波賣壓的重要背景。Meta(META-US) 將2026年資本支出預測下限上調至1,350億美元，自由現金流轉負，股價週四下跌7%。
這反映出，即使企業營收表現優於預期，投資人仍可能因資本支出持續攀升而降低持股意願。
高盛內部對後市看法仍有分歧，認為持股調整可能為科技股帶來反彈契機，但AI需求成長能否轉化為足以支撐龐大投資的現金流，仍是市場面臨的關鍵考驗。

避險基金加速降槓桿 科技股遭集中拋售

高盛Prime部門數據顯示，基本面多空基金經Beta調整後的淨槓桿，本週下降3.5個百分點，10月以來累計下滑10.3個百分點，降至一年低點，在過去3年的歷史分布中位於第14百分位。
過去8個交易日中，避險基金有7天降低槓桿，調整速度超過2025年全年的任何時期。
週四的降槓桿規模更排名今年以來第5大，且完全由多頭部位遭到拋售所推動。基本面多空基金淨槓桿率降至47%，落在過去3年歷史區間的第1百分位，顯示基金正大幅削減風險曝險。
高盛Tony Pasquariello週五（23日）在報告中指出，從與客戶溝通的情況來看，這波賣壓已波及市場核心持股，週四科技股部位的減持規模，更創下近2年來單日最高紀錄。
不過，資金並非全面撤出美股。週四費城半導體指數重挫6.7%，標普500指數卻有337檔成分股上漲，指數整體僅下跌1.2%。標普500非AI成分股指數10月上漲6.5%，有望創下近3年來最佳單月表現。
這種分化顯示，市場對AI相關資產的態度正從普遍追捧轉向更加挑剔，投資人不再願意不加區分地為AI題材支付溢價。

AI交易熱度大減 高盛看好獲利預期穩定的龍頭

AI交易降溫，也反映在高盛相關投資組合的表現。高盛AI與AI風險避險組合（GSPUARTI）在6月22日升至583.45點後轉跌，最新報261.71點，較高點回落約55%。
高盛高Beta動能組合（GSPRHIMO）今年以來的漲幅也已全數吐回，較6月高點下跌約43%，重新測試7月低點。
此外，高盛AI受益股組合（GSTMTAIP）相較標普500非AI成分股指數（SPXXAI）的單日表現，跌至DeepSeek衝擊以來最差水準，廣泛AI概念股相對大盤的表現也回落至夏季低點。
儘管如此，高盛策略師Louis Miller認為，持股降溫與股價修正不代表AI投資邏輯已經失效。
他提出3項逢低布局的依據：投資人的動能曝險已降至2025年6月以來最低水準、本輪股價修正幅度可觀，使部分資產的風險報酬比有所改善，以及AI龍頭企業的獲利預期仍維持穩定。
其中，獲利預期是高盛判斷部分AI資產可能反彈的關鍵。該行指出，超大規模雲端服務商的獲利預期自7月以來並未下修，資料中心設備產業也尚未出現獲利成長放緩的跡象。
換言之，如果企業獲利前景維持穩定，而股價已大幅回落，部分AI資產就可能具備反彈空間。
但高盛也提醒，市場尚未完全擺脫交易過度擁擠的風險。儘管動能曝險已明顯下降，目前仍處於歷史分布的第73百分位，顯示相關部位仍高於長期多數時期的水準。

高盛建議選擇性布局 AI資本支出回報成關鍵

高盛並未因此轉為全面看多AI，而是建議有選擇地布局相關資產，並保留避險。該行一方面看好部分AI受益股在持股調整後的反彈機會，另一方面也警惕非AI股票短期漲勢過快，並將投資重點轉向表後發電、園區自建發電等領域，同時避開週期性及品質較差的股票。
這項策略反映出，高盛認為AI產業鏈的投資機會正逐漸分化。持股出清與股價回落可能創造買點，但不代表整個產業已經觸底。
Pasquariello坦言，自己對市場後續方向「信念有限」，並指出，算力需求有解決途徑，但資本成本問題仍未找到答案。
隨著AI資本支出持續擴大，市場關注的焦點已不再只是雲端服務商會投入多少資金，而是這些支出能否帶來足夠的營收、獲利與自由現金流。Meta股價的反應便凸顯，即使業務成長強勁，若投資回報未能跟上支出擴張，股價與估值仍可能承受壓力。
歷史數據同樣顯示，動能交易大幅回檔後，後續走勢未必一致。高盛數據顯示，動能組合回落10%後，未來3個月的中位數報酬率為16.4%；然而，2026年3月低點後的反彈最終全數回吐，而7月觸底後，該組合又在隨後一個月進一步下跌15.4%。
下週，微軟(MSFT-US) 與Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 將在聯準會公布利率決議後數小時內陸續發布財報，亞馬遜則將於週四跟進。相關財報將成為市場檢視AI投資回報的重要依據。
在資本支出持續攀升、現金流回報仍待驗證的情況下，高盛現階段的策略並非押注AI類股全面反彈，而是鎖定獲利前景穩定、股價已大幅修正的標的，等待市場重新評估其投資價值。
paras_en: U.S. AI trading has recently faced a fresh wave of selling pressure, prompting hedge funds to accelerate deleveraging and dramatically adjust their tech stock holdings. Goldman Sachs believes the market cool‑down has created a layout opportunity for some AI‑related stocks, but a broad bottom‑fishing is still premature; the key hinges on whether leading firms can sustain profit expectations and whether massive AI capital spending can ultimately be turned into sufficient cash flow.

According to Goldman data, the firm’s hedge‑fund VIP portfolio posted its worst single‑day performance since 2011 on Thursday (the 22nd), while its bulk‑brokerage tech‑stock sell volume hit a new high not seen since September 2024.

At the same time, the S&P 500 non‑AI component index has, for the first time this year, outperformed the overall S&P 500, indicating that the excess‑return premium driven by AI stocks over the past three years is waning.

The market’s reassessment of AI investment costs and returns underpins this sell‑off. Meta (META‑US) raised the lower bound of its 2026 capital‑expenditure forecast to $135 billion, turned free cash flow negative, and saw its share price drop 7% on Thursday.
This shows that even when a company’s revenue beats expectations, investors may still curb exposure if capital spending keeps climbing.

Goldman’s internal views on the outlook remain divided; while the portfolio adjustments could set up a rebound for tech stocks, the crucial test remains whether AI demand growth can translate into cash flow sufficient to support the huge investments.

Hedge funds are speeding up deleveraging and tech stocks are being sold off en masse. Goldman’s Prime data show that the net leverage of fundamental long‑short funds, after beta adjustment, fell 3.5 percentage points this week, a cumulative drop of 10.3 points since October, reaching a one‑year low and placing it in the 14th percentile of the past three‑year distribution.
In the past eight trading days, hedge funds reduced leverage on seven days, a pace faster than any period in 2025.

Thursday’s deleveraging was the fifth‑largest this year and was driven entirely by the sale of long positions. The net leverage of fundamental long‑short funds fell to 47%, landing in the 1st percentile of the three‑year historical range, indicating a sharp cut in risk exposure.

Goldman’s Tony Pasquariello noted on Friday (the 23rd) that, based on client communications, the sell‑off has reached core market holdings, with Thursday’s tech‑stock reductions setting a two‑year single‑day high.

However, capital has not fled U.S. equities entirely. While the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index plunged 6.7% on Thursday, 337 S&P 500 components rose, limiting the index’s decline to 1.2%. The S&P 500 non‑AI component index rose 6.5% in October, on track for its best monthly performance in nearly three years.
This divergence shows the market’s attitude toward AI‑related assets shifting from broad enthusiasm to greater selectivity, with investors no longer willing to pay a blanket premium for AI themes.

AI trading heat has cooled, and Goldman’s related portfolios reflect that. The Goldman AI and AI‑Risk Hedge portfolio (GSPUARTI) peaked at 583.45 points on June 22 before falling to 261.71, roughly a 55% drop from its high.
Goldman’s high‑beta momentum portfolio (GSPRHIMO) has given back all its gains this year, down about 43% from its June peak and retesting July lows.

Moreover, Goldman’s AI Beneficiary portfolio (GSTMTAIP) has fallen to its worst level since the DeepSeek shock relative to the S&P 500 non‑AI index (SPXXAI), with broad AI concepts lagging the market back to summer lows.
Nevertheless, Goldman strategist Louis Miller argues that cooler holdings and price corrections do not mean the AI investment thesis has failed.

He cites three reasons to consider buying on dips: investor momentum exposure is at its lowest since June 2025, the current price correction is sizable enough to improve risk‑adjusted returns for some assets, and profit expectations for AI leaders remain stable.

Profit expectations are the key factor in Goldman’s view that certain AI assets could rebound. The firm notes that profit forecasts for the largest cloud service providers have not been revised downward since July, and data‑center equipment makers show no sign of slowing profit growth.
In other words, if corporate earnings outlooks stay steady while prices have fallen sharply, some AI assets may have upside potential.

Goldman also warns that the market has not fully escaped the risk of overly crowded trades. Although momentum exposure has fallen markedly, it still sits at the 73rd percentile of its historical distribution, indicating that related positions remain above long‑term averages.

Goldman does not now advocate a blanket bullish stance on AI but recommends a selective allocation while retaining hedges. The firm sees rebound opportunities in certain AI beneficiary stocks after the sell‑off, cautions that non‑AI stocks may be rising too fast in the short term, and is shifting focus toward post‑generation power, on‑site renewable generation, and away from cyclical or lower‑quality equities.

This strategy reflects Goldman’s view that investment opportunities within the AI supply chain are becoming increasingly differentiated. Portfolio clean‑outs and price declines may create buying points, but they do not signal a sector‑wide bottom.
Pasquariello admits his confidence in the market’s direction is limited, noting that while compute‑power demand has solutions, the capital‑cost issue remains unresolved.

As AI capital spending continues to expand, market focus has moved beyond how much cloud providers will invest to whether those expenditures can generate enough revenue, profit and free cash flow. Meta’s stock reaction underscores that strong business growth alone cannot sustain valuation if investment returns lag spending expansion.

Historical data also show that after a sharp pull‑back in momentum trading, subsequent performance is not uniform. Goldman data indicate that after a 10% drop in a momentum portfolio, the median three‑month return is 16.4%; however, the rebound from the March 2026 low was fully erased, and after the July trough the portfolio fell another 15.4% in the following month.

Next week, Microsoft (MSFT‑US) and Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) will release earnings a few hours after the Fed’s rate decision, with Amazon following on Thursday. Those reports will be key gauges of AI investment returns for the market.

Given rising capital expenditures and still‑unproven cash‑flow returns, Goldman’s current strategy is not a bet on a universal AI rally but a focus on targets with stable profit outlooks and heavily corrected prices, awaiting a market re‑assessment of their investment value.

items.title: AI崩盤終極推演：泡沫在2028年初破裂 美科技股斷崖式崩跌40%
items.title_en: AI Crash Ultimate Scenario: Bubble Bursts Early 2028, US Tech Stocks Plunge 40%
paras: AI投資熱潮若走向終結，美股將承受多大衝擊？TS Lombard首席宏觀策略師Dario Perkins在10月22日報告中推演，AI泡沫可能於2028年初破裂，屆時美國科技股恐重挫40%、標普500指數下跌30%，約20兆美元市值蒸發。不過，這項情境分析認為，美國較可能陷入溫和衰退，而非重演2008年金融危機。
投資支撐營收 外部需求仍待考驗
TS Lombard指出，美國科技公司每年投入AI建設的金額約達1兆美元，已成為史上最大規模的基礎建設投資之一，超大規模雲端服務商的資本支出占美國國內生產毛額（GDP）比重也接近歷史高峰。
然而，AI生態系的營收成長，很大程度仍仰賴「資本支出循環」，也就是一家公司的投資，成為另一家公司的營收。只要科技巨頭持續投入資金，產業內部收入便能擴張，但這不等於商業模式已具備永續性。
報告認為，真正的關鍵是一般消費者與非科技企業帶來的收入占比能否提高，目前這方面幾乎沒有改善。報告並指出，OpenAI與Anthropic約80%的營收來自僅1%的客戶，而這些客戶多為依賴創投資金的虧損AI新創，讓整個體系更加依賴持續融資。
六大風險 任何一項都可能引爆危機
報告列出六項可能刺破泡沫的因素，首先是營收不如預期。要讓目前的資本支出取得合理回報，AI產業到2030年的年營收須達2.5兆至3兆美元，約為目前的14倍。但消費者付費意願有限，加上中國開放權重模型搶占市場，AI服務面臨商品化壓力。
其次是信用風險。科技巨頭過去主要以自身現金流支應投資，如今新增資金需求愈來愈仰賴舉債。報告估計，AI企業2027年將發行約7,000億美元新債，其中4,000億美元來自超大規模雲端服務商。整個生態系的隱性負債估計已達1.5兆至2兆美元，部分新興雲端服務商的融資利率更高達15%。
第三是折舊與租金壓力。資料中心施工期間尚無須提列折舊，部分多年期租約也要等正式營運才開始計入成本。隨著更多設施啟用，相關支出將陸續浮現，可能在12個月內大幅改變AI企業的財務狀況。
第四是首次公開發行（IPO）帶來的資訊揭露。報告指出，Anthropic與OpenAI均有上市計畫，後者已延至2027年。IPO可能讓投資人首次更完整檢視AI企業的真實財務表現，考驗目前以年度經常性收入（ARR）等指標支撐的成長敘事。
第五是半導體循環與供應鏈風險。報告指出，輝達（NVIDIA）透過供應商融資協助客戶購買晶片，進一步加深產業內部的資金循環。一旦需求放緩，供應鏈的「牛鞭效應」可能放大波動，讓目前的硬體短缺迅速轉為過剩。
第六是監管與安全風險。報告引述調查指出，約55%的美國人希望放慢AI發展，僅13%反對。若發生重大安全事故，可能引發政治反彈與更嚴格的監管。
不必停止投資 增速放慢就可能出事
TS Lombard強調，AI資本支出不需要實際下降，只要成長速度放緩，就可能引發金融壓力，這是整場繁榮最脆弱之處。
目前，前沿AI實驗室承諾向資料中心業者支付數十億美元，業者再以合約為基礎借款興建設施。但這些實驗室本身尚未獲利，付款能力仰賴持續取得資金。
一旦科技巨頭放慢投入，壓力便可能沿著融資與合約關係傳遞，衝擊整個AI生態系。
科技股恐跌40% 損失集中股權市場
依報告設定的崩盤情境，標普500指數可能下跌30%，科技股重挫40%，其他類股下跌約20%，合計蒸發約20兆美元市值，科技股占美國市場的權重將退回ChatGPT推出前的水準。
目前美國科技類股本益比約30倍，雖低於一年前的40倍，也遠低於網路泡沫時期的70至75倍，但產業集中度仍使市場面臨重大衝擊。
大型科技公司可望憑藉強健的資產負債表撐過危機，較脆弱的環節則包括新興雲端服務商、甲骨文、獨立模型開發商，以及建築與設備供應商。
報告假設2028至2030年間累計違約率為35%、回收率為25%至50%，估算信用損失約1,250億至1,900億美元。相較之下，股權投資人將承受最大損失，但整體金融體系不至於出現2008年式的連鎖信用危機。
經濟恐溫和衰退 降息提供緩衝
在總體經濟方面，報告估計，AI資料中心投資熱潮結束，將使美國GDP水準下降約2個百分點。由於相關投資高度仰賴進口，進口同步減少，可部分抵銷資本支出下滑的衝擊。
AI建設目前已創造約50萬個工作機會，預計2027年底增至80萬個。若這些職位全部消失，在不計更廣泛商業信心影響下，美國失業率可能上升約0.5個百分點。
不過，TS Lombard認為，衰退程度較可能接近1990年或2001年。原因在於民間部門資產負債表仍健康，聯準會也有充足降息空間，可帶動耐久財消費、住宅市場及其他非AI領域的需求。
較大的尾端風險是，企業可能在景氣轉差後加速採用AI自動化，以削減成本。若因此擴大裁員，勞動市場衝擊可能超出預期，形成緩慢的「無就業復甦」。
美元恐承壓 但過早押注崩盤也有風險
報告將AI崩盤視為需求衝擊，預期長期利率將明顯下降，公債的避險功能重新增強，但溫和衰退不代表利率將重返零水準，或需要永久量化寬鬆。
由於這波熱潮集中於少數美國與亞洲企業，AI供應鏈核心市場可能受到較大衝擊。歐洲等參與程度較低的市場，則可能在初期恐慌賣壓過後，表現優於美股。美元也可能面臨壓力，資金轉向歐元、日元與英鎊等貨幣。
不過，TS Lombard並不主張現階段就放空美國科技股，或大幅增加長天期債券部位。若AI繁榮持續，過早布局可能嚴重落後市場。
報告建議參考GMO的Ben Inker提出的投資框架，透過多元化全球股票組合參與行情，同時降低集中押注美國AI科技股的風險，待生態系出現明確壓力訊號，再逐步增加政府公債配置。
paras_en: If the AI investment frenzy comes to an end, how much impact will US equities feel? TS Lombard chief macro strategist Dario Perkins projected in a October 22 report that the AI bubble could burst in early 2028, at which point US technology stocks could tumble 40% and the S&P 500 could fall 30%, wiping out about $20 trillion in market value. The scenario, however, assumes the US is more likely to slip into a mild recession rather than repeat the 2008 financial crisis.
Investment supports revenue; external demand still untested

TS Lombard notes that US tech firms spend roughly $1 trillion a year on AI infrastructure, making it one of the largest ever capital‑investment programmes, and capital spending by mega‑scale cloud providers now approaches a historic peak as a share of US GDP.

Nevertheless, revenue growth in the AI ecosystem still largely depends on a “capital‑spending cycle,” where one company’s investment becomes another’s revenue. As long as tech giants keep pouring money in, internal industry revenues can expand, but that does not mean the business model is sustainable.

The report says the real key is whether the share of revenue coming from ordinary consumers and non‑tech firms can rise – and so far it has not. It points out that about 80% of OpenAI’s and Anthropic’s revenue comes from just 1% of customers, many of which are loss‑making AI startups funded by venture capital, making the whole system more dependent on continual financing.
Six major risks – any one could trigger a crisis

The report lists six factors that could puncture the bubble, starting with revenue falling short of expectations. To justify current cap‑ex, AI industry annual revenue would need to reach $2.5‑$3 trillion by 2030 – about 14 times today – but consumer willingness to pay is limited and Chinese open‑weight models are grabbing market share, putting pressure on AI services to become commoditized.

Second is credit risk. Tech giants previously funded investments largely from cash flow; now new funding needs rely increasingly on borrowing. The report estimates AI firms will issue about $700 billion of new debt in 2027, $400 billion of which will come from mega‑scale cloud providers. Implicit liabilities across the ecosystem are estimated at $1.5‑$2 trillion, with some emerging cloud players facing financing rates as high as 15%.

Third is depreciation and lease‑cost pressure. Data‑center construction does not incur depreciation until operational, and many long‑term leases only start counting as costs once the facilities are running. As more sites come online, related expenses will surface, potentially reshaping AI firms’ financials dramatically within a 12‑month window.

Fourth is the information disclosure that comes with an IPO. The report notes both Anthropic and OpenAI have listing plans, with OpenAI’s IPO now pushed to 2027. An IPO could give investors a fuller view of AI companies’ true financial performance, testing growth narratives that currently rely on metrics such as annual recurring revenue (ARR).

Fifth is the semiconductor cycle and supply‑chain risk. The report points out NVIDIA helps customers finance chip purchases through supplier financing, deepening internal capital flows. If demand eases, the supply‑chain “bullwhip” effect could amplify volatility, turning current hardware shortages into oversupply quickly.

Sixth is regulatory and safety risk. The report cites a survey showing about 55% of Americans want AI development slowed, with only 13% opposed. A major safety incident could spark political backlash and tighter regulation.
No need to stop investing; a slowdown alone could cause trouble
TS Lombard stresses that AI cap‑ex does not need to fall – a slowdown in growth speed alone could create financial strain, which is the most fragile point of the whole boom.

Currently frontier AI labs pledge to pay data‑center operators tens of billions of dollars, with operators borrowing against contracts to build facilities. These labs themselves are still unprofitable, and their ability to pay depends on continued funding.
If tech giants ease their spending, pressure could travel through financing and contract relationships, hitting the entire AI ecosystem.
Tech stocks could fall 40% – losses concentrated in equity markets

Under the report’s crash scenario, the S&P 500 could drop 30%, tech stocks could plunge 40%, other sectors about 20%, erasing roughly $20 trillion of market value, and tech’s weight in the US market would revert to pre‑ChatGPT levels.

US tech stocks now trade at a price‑to‑earnings multiple of about 30× – lower than the 40× a year ago and far below the 70‑75× seen in the dot‑com bubble – but industry concentration still leaves the market vulnerable to a major shock.

Large tech firms with strong balance sheets could weather the crisis, while more vulnerable points include emerging cloud providers, Oracle, independent model developers, and construction and equipment suppliers.

The report assumes cumulative default rates of 35% and recovery rates of 25%‑50% between 2028 and 2030, estimating credit losses of $125‑$190 billion. Compared with that, equity investors would bear the biggest losses, but the overall financial system would likely avoid a chain‑reaction credit crisis like in 2008.
Economy likely to face a mild recession; rate cuts provide a buffer

On the macro side, the report estimates that the end of the AI data‑center investment boom would shave roughly two percentage points off US GDP. Because the spending is heavily import‑dependent, a drop in imports would partially offset the impact of lower cap‑ex.

AI construction has created about 500,000 jobs so far and is expected to rise to 800,000 by the end of 2027. If all those positions vanished, US unemployment could rise about 0.5 percentage points, not counting broader confidence effects.

TS Lombard, however, believes the recession would likely resemble the early‑1990s or 2001 downturns. The private‑sector balance sheets remain healthy and the Fed still has ample room to cut rates, which could boost durable‑goods consumption, the housing market and demand in non‑AI sectors.

A larger tail risk is that firms might accelerate AI automation after the slowdown to cut costs. If that triggers larger layoffs, labor‑market impacts could exceed expectations, creating a slow “no‑employment recovery.”
The dollar could come under pressure, but betting on a crash too early also carries risk

The report treats an AI crash as a demand shock, expecting long‑term rates to fall markedly, reviving the safe‑haven role of Treasuries, but a mild recession does not mean rates will return to zero nor require permanent quantitative easing.

Because the frenzy is concentrated in a handful of US and Asian firms, the core AI supply‑chain market could feel a bigger hit. Regions with lower exposure, such as Europe, may initially see panic selling but could later outperform US equities. The dollar may also face pressure as capital shifts to the euro, yen and pound.

Nonetheless, TS Lombard does not recommend short‑selling US tech stocks now or dramatically increasing long‑dated bond positions. If the AI boom continues, moving too early could leave investors far behind the market.

The report suggests following the investment framework proposed by GMO’s Ben Inker, using a diversified global equity portfolio to capture the rally while reducing concentration in US AI tech stocks, and only adding government bond exposure gradually once clear stress signals appear in the ecosystem.

items.title: 英特爾2045年3D晶片布局曝光！高層示警先進晶圓產能難增10倍
items.title_en: Intel Reveals 2045 3D Chip Roadmap! Exec Warns Advanced Wafer Capacity Won’t Grow Tenfold
paras: 隨著人工智慧（AI）算力需求持續攀升，先進晶圓製造的產能擴張正面臨設備供應與製造成本等挑戰。英特爾(INTC-US) 技術長Pushkar Ranade指出，以全球現有半導體製造設備規模來看，先進製程晶圓產量要擴大10倍並不容易，相較之下，提升至約2倍更具現實可能性。
根據科技Podcast《Dwarkesh Podcast》10月22日發布的英特爾晶圓廠探訪與高階主管訪談，先進製程的發展瓶頸不只在於晶片設計與製程微縮，還涉及極紫外光（EUV）微影設備、蝕刻與薄膜沉積設備等上游供應能力。若要進一步擴大產能，設備供應鏈也必須同步成長。
訪談也將焦點延伸至未來20年的晶片製造技術，涵蓋英特爾14A製程、高數值孔徑極紫外光（High-NA EUV）微影、背面供電、互補場效電晶體（CFET）及混合鍵合等技術，探討晶圓廠如何突破現有製造模式的限制。

英特爾14A研發逾3年　避免重蹈10奈米延期覆轍

英特爾主管Chris Auth透露，14A製程已研發超過3年，一套先進製程涉及約2,000道製造步驟。從研發走向量產，除了設備配置與製程最佳化，缺陷控制及良率提升也是重要工作，必須確保製程能夠穩定投入大規模生產。
英特爾過去曾因10奈米製程延遲而面臨挑戰，原因包括過於積極的電晶體密度提升目標，以及同時導入複雜的製程創新。
為降低類似風險，公司如今透過技術成熟度評估與階段性審查機制，控制單一製程節點同時導入重大創新的數量，提升量產時程的可預測性。
在微影技術方面，High-NA EUV是14A的重要技術選項之一。這項技術將數值孔徑從0.33提高至0.55，單次曝光的解析能力可提升約1.7倍。
英特爾認為，搭配背面供電技術，High-NA EUV有望減少部分複雜圖形所需的多重曝光步驟，但實際採用與否，仍須考量成本及客戶的晶片設計需求。
背面供電則是另一項重要發展方向。傳統晶片的電源與訊號布線主要位於電晶體上方，背面供電技術將電源網路移至晶圓背面，釋放正面布線空間，有助改善供電效率、減少互連擁擠，為先進製程持續微縮創造條件。

電晶體走向3D堆疊　鈀以外的新材料也受關注

面向2045年的晶片製造，電晶體架構可能進一步從平面排列走向真正的3D堆疊。
英特爾正在研究CFET架構，將N型與P型電晶體上下堆疊，以提高單位面積內的電晶體密度。更長遠來看，晶片可能形成多層電晶體與互連結構交替堆疊的設計，但散熱、蝕刻、材料填充及製造成本，仍是必須克服的挑戰。
晶片內部的金屬互連也面臨材料選擇的問題。當互連間距縮小至約20奈米，傳統銅互連所需的襯裡材料會占據愈來愈多空間，壓縮實際導電區域。英特爾因此研究釕（Ru）等材料，希望改善極細互連線的有效電阻表現；不過，在尺寸較大的互連結構中，銅仍將扮演重要角色。
先進封裝則是提高晶片整合密度的另一條路徑。英特爾的Foveros技術已實現25微米互連間距，並持續研究10微米以下的混合鍵合技術。訪談也提及，學術研究已展現0.45微米間距的可靠性成果。
混合鍵合有望進一步提高晶片之間的連接密度，降低資料傳輸功耗，讓邏輯晶片與記憶體更緊密整合，成為未來高效能運算架構的重要技術方向。

追趕台積電不只看製程　晶圓廠也須重新設計

談到與台積電(2330-TW) 的競爭，Ranade認為，不能只以電晶體密度、效能或功耗的細微差距衡量技術實力。晶圓廠規模、良率、客戶生態系、準時交付能力及快速擴產的能力，同樣是晶圓代工業者競爭力的重要組成部分。
他認為，英特爾在技術上已具備競爭能力，但在生產規模方面仍須追趕台積電。
另一方面，先進晶圓廠的建置成本持續攀升，High-NA EUV及相關設備的投資規模已達數億美元等級。
Ranade指出，半導體產業不能永遠沿用過去數十年的製造模式，必須重新檢視無塵室設計、設備配置、製程流程及晶圓廠的建置方式，尋找成本更低、效率更高的生產體系。
paras_en: As AI compute demand keeps climbing, expanding capacity for advanced wafer manufacturing faces challenges such as equipment supply and manufacturing costs. Intel (INTC-US) CTO Pushkar Ranade said that, given the current global semiconductor equipment base, scaling advanced‑process wafer output ten‑fold is difficult, while a roughly two‑fold increase is more realistic.

According to the technology podcast “Dwarkesh Podcast” episode released on October 22, which featured a tour of Intel’s fabs and interviews with senior executives, the bottleneck for advanced processes is not only chip design and node shrinkage but also upstream supply of extreme‑ultraviolet (EUV) lithography tools, etch and thin‑film deposition equipment. To expand capacity further, the equipment supply chain must grow in tandem.

The interview also looked ahead 20 years to future chip‑manufacturing technologies, covering Intel’s 14A process, high‑numerical‑aperture EUV lithography, backside power delivery, complementary‑FET (CFET) and heterogeneous bonding, and examined how fabs can break the limits of current manufacturing models.

Intel’s 14A has been under development for more than three years, according to Intel executive Chris Auth, and a single advanced node involves about 2,000 manufacturing steps. Moving from R&D to volume production requires not only equipment configuration and process optimization but also defect control and yield improvement to ensure the process can be reliably scaled to high volume.
Intel previously faced challenges when its 10‑nm node slipped, due to overly aggressive transistor‑density targets and the simultaneous introduction of multiple complex process innovations.

To lower similar risks, the company now uses technology‑readiness assessments and staged review mechanisms to limit the number of major innovations introduced at a single node, improving predictability of volume‑production timelines.
In lithography, High‑NA EUV is a key option for 14A. The technology raises the numerical aperture from 0.33 to 0.55, boosting single‑exposure resolution capability by roughly 1.7×.

Intel believes that, when combined with backside power delivery, High‑NA EUV could reduce the number of multiple‑exposure steps needed for some complex patterns, though actual adoption will depend on cost and customer chip‑design requirements.

Backside power delivery is another important direction. Traditional chips route power and signals above the transistors; backside power moves the power network to the wafer’s back side, freeing front‑side routing space, improving power efficiency, and easing interconnect congestion, thereby supporting continued node shrinkage.
Looking toward 2045, transistor architectures may move from planar layouts to true 3D stacking.

Intel is researching CFET architectures that stack n‑type and p‑type transistors vertically to increase transistor density per unit area. In the longer term, chips could feature alternating layers of transistors and interconnects, but challenges such as heat removal, etching, material filling and cost must be overcome.

Metal interconnects inside chips also face material‑selection issues. As interconnect pitch shrinks to about 20 nm, the barrier material needed for traditional copper takes up an increasing fraction of the space, reducing the actual conductive area. Intel is therefore exploring materials such as ruthenium (Ru) to improve the effective resistance of ultra‑fine lines, although copper will remain important for larger‑pitch structures.

Advanced packaging is another path to higher integration density. Intel’s Foveros technology has achieved a 25‑micron interconnect pitch and continues to explore hybrid bonding below 10 microns. The interview also noted academic work showing reliable results at a 0.45‑micron pitch.

Hybrid bonding is expected to further raise inter‑chip connection density and lower data‑transfer power, enabling tighter logic‑to‑memory integration and becoming a key technology for future high‑performance computing architectures.

When discussing competition with TSMC (2330‑TW), Ranade said that technology strength cannot be judged solely by marginal differences in transistor density, performance or power. Wafer‑fab size, yield, customer ecosystem, on‑time delivery and rapid capacity expansion are equally important components of a foundry’s competitiveness.
He believes Intel has the technical capability to compete, but still needs to catch up with TSMC in production scale.
Meanwhile, the cost of building advanced fabs continues to rise, with investments in High‑NA EUV and related equipment reaching the hundreds‑of‑millions‑of‑dollars level.

Ranade pointed out that the semiconductor industry cannot keep using manufacturing models that have been in place for decades; it must re‑examine clean‑room design, equipment layout, process flow and fab construction to find lower‑cost, higher‑efficiency production systems.

items.title: 馬斯克再對烏克蘭開砲！稱烏軍違規將星鏈用於攻擊無人機、「漏洞」已堵上
items.title_en: Musk Fires at Ukraine Again, Says Ukrainian Forces Misused Starlink for Drone Attacks and the ‘Vulnerability’ Has Been Closed
paras: SpaceX(SPCX-US) 執行長馬斯克週日（25日）表示，烏克蘭軍方違反服務條款，將旗下衛星網路服務「星鏈」（Starlink）用於攻擊型無人機打擊，相關漏洞已於上周封堵。
他強調，星鏈是民用商業服務，不應被用於支援攻擊行動，但也指出，這套系統對烏克蘭防禦俄羅斯的戰事仍至關重要。
馬斯克是在社群平台 X 回應一名用戶有關星鏈並非武器系統的貼文時，進一步說明星鏈與「星盾」（Starshield）的區別。
他表示，星鏈從來不允許、也不應被允許用於支援攻擊型無人機殺人；星盾則是另一套由美國政府管控的系統，如何運用應由美方自行決定。
馬斯克指出，星鏈對烏克蘭防禦仍具有關鍵作用，因為截至目前，這是唯一無法被干擾或摧毀的通訊系統。
他警告，若星鏈停止提供服務，烏克蘭前線將立即崩潰，並強調這不是威脅，而是對現實情況的陳述。
他回顧俄烏戰爭初期，俄羅斯摧毀或干擾了其他通訊手段，星鏈因此在阻止俄軍迅速占領烏克蘭的過程中發揮關鍵作用。
馬斯克並稱，在支援烏克蘭防務方面，SpaceX 的貢獻超過全球任何一家民營企業。
不過，馬斯克也對持續支持戰爭的人士表達強烈不滿，批評他們一方面鼓吹無止境的殺戮，另一方面卻拿不出任何可行的衝突解決方案，最後更以「願他們下地獄」表達鄙夷。
paras_en: SpaceX (SPCX-US) CEO Elon Musk said on Sunday (the 25th) that the Ukrainian military violated the service terms by using its satellite internet service Starlink for attacking drones, and the related vulnerability was patched last week.

He stressed that Starlink is a civilian commercial service and should not be used to support offensive actions, but also noted that the system remains crucial for Ukraine’s defense against Russia’s war.
Musk made the comments on the social platform X in response to a user’s post that Starlink is not a weapons system, and he further explained the difference between Starlink and “Starshield.”

He said Starlink has never been allowed, nor should it ever be allowed, to support lethal attack drones; Starshield is a separate system controlled by the U.S. government, and its use should be decided by the United States.
Musk pointed out that Starlink remains critical to Ukraine’s defense because, to date, it is the only communications system that cannot be jammed or destroyed.
He warned that if Starlink service were halted, the Ukrainian front lines would collapse immediately, emphasizing that this is not a threat but a statement of reality.
He recalled that early in the Russia‑Ukraine war Russia destroyed or jammed other communications means, and Starlink played a key role in preventing Russian forces from quickly overrunning Ukraine.
Musk also claimed that SpaceX’s contribution to supporting Ukraine’s defense exceeds that of any other private company worldwide.

However, Musk expressed strong displeasure with those who continue to support the war, criticizing them for glorifying endless killing while offering no viable solutions to the conflict, and concluding with a contemptuous wish that they “go to hell.”

items.title: 澤倫斯基改口了？願凍結俄烏戰線又拒絕割地、美施壓和平談判
items.title_en: Zelensky Changes His Tune? Willing to Freeze the Russia-Ukraine Front Yet Refuses Territorial Concessions, US Pressures Peace Talks
paras: 烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基表示，烏克蘭希望盡快結束與俄羅斯的軍事衝突，也願意透過協議實現停火，但不會為了達成和平而放棄更多領土，與他此前的說法不同。
澤倫斯基21日接受美國《福斯新聞》（Fox News）直播訪問時，曾表示願意在保留至少75%領土控制權的前提下達成和平協議
當時，主持人詢問他是否接受凍結現狀、讓烏克蘭保有75%或更多領土的方案，澤倫斯基回答肯定，並稱凍結現狀是結束戰爭的可行途徑。
然而，根據烏克蘭通訊社報導，澤倫斯基23日接受《ABC》訪問時強調，烏方願為停火達成協議，但拒絕接受放棄25%領土的提議。
他指出，俄軍目前實際控制烏克蘭約19.3%的領土，若要求烏方割讓25%的領土，將迫使烏克蘭放棄頓巴斯尚未遭俄軍占領的地區，這是烏方無法接受的條件。
澤倫斯基也對美國近期減少對烏援助表達遺憾。他透露，過去3個月，烏克蘭僅從美國獲得24枚「愛國者」（Patriot）防空系統攔截飛彈，遠遠無法滿足實際需求。
他指出，光是22日晚間，基輔就遭到30枚彈道飛彈襲擊，而烏克蘭平均每月需要350枚愛國者飛彈。
據美媒報導，美國近期加大對澤倫斯基的施壓，要求烏克蘭作出讓步，以促成與俄羅斯達成和平協議。美國總統川普則多次指責烏克蘭是美方斡旋的和平談判遲遲未取得進展的原因。
俄羅斯總統普丁22日表示，俄美已就重啟三方會談達成共識。他指出，會談目標不只是促成短暫停火，而是討論和平協議最終達成後，如何確保俄羅斯與烏克蘭的安全。
俄羅斯與烏克蘭23日則分別證實，雙方同意自27日起在赫爾松地區的奧列什基（Oleshky）停火。另有美國官員透露，俄、美、烏三方可能在兩週內於阿拉伯聯合大公國阿布達比或瑞士舉行會談。
澤倫斯基表示，希望後續能進一步舉行三國領導人會晤；普丁則重申，任何三方會談都應聚焦於和平協議達成後的俄烏安全保障。
paras_en: Ukrainian President Zelensky says Ukraine wants to end the military conflict with Russia as soon as possible, is willing to achieve a cease‑fire through an agreement, but will not give up more territory for peace, contrary to his earlier statements.
On the 21st, Zelensky told Fox News in a live interview that he would be ready to reach a peace deal provided Ukraine retained control of at least 75% of its territory.

The host asked whether he would accept a frozen‑status proposal that would let Ukraine keep 75% or more of its land; Zelensky answered affirmatively and said freezing the situation was a viable way to end the war.

However, according to the Ukrainian news agency, Zelensky said in an ABC interview on the 23rd that Ukraine is willing to negotiate a cease‑fire but rejects any proposal that would require ceding 25% of its territory.

He noted that Russian forces currently control about 19.3% of Ukraine, and demanding a 25% territorial concession would force Ukraine to give up parts of Donbas that are not yet occupied, a condition Kyiv cannot accept.

Zelensky also expressed regret over the United States’ recent reduction in aid. He revealed that in the past three months Ukraine has received only 24 Patriot air‑defence missiles from the U.S., far short of its needs.
He added that just on the night of the 22nd Kyiv was hit by 30 ballistic missiles, while Ukraine needs an average of 350 Patriot missiles per month.

U.S. media report that Washington has stepped up pressure on Zelensky, urging Kyiv to make concessions to facilitate a peace deal with Russia. Former President Trump has repeatedly blamed Ukraine for the stalled progress of U.S‑mediated negotiations.

Russian President Putin said on the 22nd that Russia and the United States have reached a consensus to restart the three‑party talks. He said the talks aim not only at a temporary cease‑fire but also at how to guarantee the security of both Russia and Ukraine after a final peace agreement is reached.

Russia and Ukraine each confirmed on the 23rd that they have agreed to a cease‑fire in Oleshky, Kherson region, starting on the 27th. A U.S. official also said the three parties may hold talks within two weeks in Abu Dhabi, UAE, or in Switzerland.

Zelensky said he hopes a subsequent meeting of the three heads of state can be arranged; Putin reiterated that any three‑party talks must focus on security guarantees for Russia and Ukraine after a peace agreement is achieved.

items.title: 歐巴馬開炮川普助攻民主黨期中選舉！痛批貪腐、伊朗戰略失當、嘲諷白宮翻修
items.title_en: Obama Fires Shots, Trump Returns the Favor for Democrats in Midterm Election! Criticizes Corruption, Iran Strategy, and Mocks White House Renovation
paras: 美國期中選舉將於11月3日登場，美國前總統歐巴馬（Barack Obama）週六（24日）為民主黨候選人站台，猛烈抨擊美國總統川普的執政表現，指控其政府充斥貪腐問題，並質疑對伊朗戰爭的戰略成效，同時嘲諷白宮翻修工程的奢華風格。
根據《路透》報導，距離這場攸關國會控制權的選舉僅剩10天，歐巴馬先後在俄亥俄州克里夫蘭及密西根州底特律出席造勢活動，將選舉定位為制衡川普政府的重要機會。
川普近期不斷呼籲選民將期中選舉視為對他本人的投票，歐巴馬週六也順勢將選戰焦點放在總統的執政紀錄上。
他在密西根州為聯邦參議員候選人埃爾薩耶德（Abdul El-Sayed）助選時，呼籲選民透過選票踩下「斷路器」，至少遏止川普政府部分不當施政，並要求政府承擔責任。
歐巴馬於2009年至2017年擔任美國總統，至今仍是民主黨的重要政治人物。民主黨希望藉由他出面助選，激勵支持者投入選戰。密西根州參議員選舉競爭激烈，埃爾薩耶德將與共和黨候選人、前聯邦眾議員羅傑斯（Mike Rogers）角逐席次。
歐巴馬在造勢場合將矛頭指向川普及共和黨，批評川普政府存在利益輸送與治理失能問題，也質疑共和黨持續配合總統的施政方向。
他表示，美國從未見過有總統如此擅長利用公職牟利，並指控川普熱衷於出售政治利益。歐巴馬更批評，共和黨如今似乎只代表貪腐、無能，甚至是不作為的政府。
白宮截至報導刊出時，尚未立即回應相關置評請求。
《路透》與益普索（Ipsos）8月進行的民調顯示，63%的美國民眾認為，川普重返白宮後，他本人及家人透過加密貨幣不當獲利；另有69%的受訪者認為，川普的政策決策受到其私人商業交易影響。
除了貪腐爭議，歐巴馬也質疑川普政府宣稱對伊朗取得勝利的說法。他指出，這場戰爭反而提高伊朗的經濟籌碼，因為伊朗威脅攻擊荷姆茲海峽航運，已對石油出口國造成不安。
歐巴馬表示，荷姆茲海峽是全球石油運輸的重要通道，如今伊朗對這條航道的通行具有實質上的否決權。
他也嘲諷川普政府將注意力放在不重要的議題上，並以諷刺口吻形容國防部長赫格塞斯（Pete Hegseth）「全神貫注於重要事務」，包括美軍官兵的下顎線條與睪固酮水準。
對於白宮翻修工程，歐巴馬同樣不留情面，批評其設計風格俗氣。他諷刺地說，川普把白宮弄得像是伊拉克前總統海珊（Saddam Hussein）開了一家起司蛋糕工廠。
paras_en: The U.S. midterm election will be held on November 3, and former President Barack Obama took the stage on Saturday (the 24th) to back Democratic candidates, launching a blistering attack on President Donald Trump’s performance in office, accusing his administration of rampant corruption, questioning the strategic effectiveness of the war on Iran, and mocking the lavish style of the White House renovation project.

According to Reuters, with only ten days left before this pivotal election that will determine control of Congress, Obama held campaign events in Cleveland, Ohio and Detroit, Michigan, framing the vote as a crucial chance to check the Trump administration.
Trump has recently been urging voters to treat the midterms as a referendum on himself, and Obama used Saturday’s appearance to shift the campaign focus onto the president’s record in office.

While campaigning in Michigan for Senate candidate Abdul El‑Sayed, Obama urged voters to flip the "circuit breaker" with their ballots, at least to curb some of the Trump administration’s improper actions and to hold the government accountable.

Obama served as U.S. president from 2009 to 2017 and remains a key figure in the Democratic Party. Democrats hope his involvement will energize supporters. The Michigan Senate race is fiercely contested, with El‑Sayed facing Republican former congressman Mike Rogers for the seat.

At the rally Obama pointed the finger at Trump and the Republican Party, criticizing the administration for cronyism and governance failures, and questioning the GOP’s continued alignment with the president’s agenda.

He said the United States has never seen a president so adept at using public office for personal profit and accused Trump of peddling political favors. Obama added that the Republican Party now seems to represent only corruption, incompetence, and even inaction.
The White House had not responded to requests for comment at the time the report was published.

A Reuters‑Ipsos poll conducted in August showed that 63% of Americans believe Trump and his family have improperly profited from cryptocurrency since his return to the White House, and 69% say his policy decisions are influenced by his private business dealings.

Beyond the corruption allegations, Obama also challenged the Trump administration’s claim of a victory over Iran, noting that the conflict has actually increased Iran’s economic leverage as Tehran threatens to attack shipping in the Hormuz Strait, unsettling oil‑exporting nations.
Obama said the Strait of Hormuz is a vital global oil‑transport corridor and that Iran now effectively holds a veto over passage through it.

He also mocked the Trump administration for focusing on trivial matters, sarcastically describing Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth as being "fully absorbed in important affairs" such as the jawlines and testosterone levels of U.S. service members.

Regarding the White House renovation, Obama was equally ruthless, criticizing its design as tacky and joking that Trump has turned the White House into a cheese‑cake factory run by former Iraqi President Saddam Hussein.

items.title: 避險潮來了黃金卻跌破4000美元、日元走強 資金開始挑剔避險資產
items.title_en: Hedging Wave Arrives as Gold Falls Below $4,000, Yen Strengthens, Funds Become Picky About Safe‑Haven Assets
paras: 黃金週五(23日)跌破每盎司4000美元，日元則走強至關鍵技術價位，美國公債也獲資金追捧，顯示全球市場避險情緒升溫，資金卻開始挑剔「避險資產」。
法國財政疑慮、人工智慧（AI）投資融資壓力與中東緊張局勢交織，投資人降低風險曝險之際，傳統避險資產的表現明顯分化。
本週市場承受多重壓力，包括法國預算赤字引發歐洲主權債務疑慮、AI資本支出能否持續獲得融資支持，以及中東地緣政治風險。美國10年期公債殖利率週四再度跌破5%，為一個月來首見，反映資金湧向美債。
黃金卻逆勢下跌，週五一度觸及每盎司3986.50美元，創逾三個月低點，本週累計跌幅達4%。
Berenberg分析師指出，黃金在避險環境下走弱，是值得關注的背離。通常美債殖利率下降，有利於不孳息的黃金，但本週投資人買進美債的同時，卻持續賣出黃金。上次金價在公債殖利率大幅下滑時如此疲弱，須追溯至2008年12月金融危機最嚴峻的階段。
投機退潮 利率預期壓抑金價
Berenberg認為，黃金弱勢與過去一年成為投機性資產有關。投機熱潮曾推升金價於今年1月突破5400美元、創歷史新高，但隨著交易者離場，金價已自高點回落逾五分之一。
芝商所首席經濟學家Erik Norland表示，今年貴金屬價格下跌的最大驅動因素，是市場預期由降息轉向升息。不過，在財政赤字侵蝕債市信心、通膨上升、地緣風險與央行持續購金等因素交織下，金價仍遠高於2025年初。
世界黃金協會數據顯示，9月央行購金量升至2024年11月以來單月最高。該協會高級市場策略師John Reade指出，高利率降低黃金投資吸引力，高能源價格則削弱消費者購金能力。今年缺乏避險買盤，基本面因素的影響更加明顯。
4000美元失守 留意ETF賣壓
多位基金經理人仍對黃金審慎樂觀，預期價格反彈，但技術面與資金面壓力增添變數。
Berenberg警告，黃金週五收盤跌破4000美元，可能引發黃金ETF進一步資金流出，以及黃金類股的技術性賣壓。
黃金ETF需求今年上半年已走弱，第三季隨9月銷售回溫而反彈，如今金價再度下探，為相關資金流向帶來新壓力。
日元走強 高盛列首選避險工具
相較於黃金，日元成為本週避險交易的主要受惠者。法國債務疑慮推動日元兌歐元升至一年高點，來到每歐元兌175.20日元；美元兌日元則跌至156.08，創五週低點。
高盛FICC分析師Chryssafis將日元列為目前AI泡沫破裂情境下的首選避險工具。美元兌日元已跌破157.50的多重底部支撐及50日均線。
高盛認為，美元資產吸引力下降、資金回流日本，有助推升日元。其長期公允價值模型顯示，日元相對美元被低估約40%，是追蹤貨幣中估值最低者。
後續升勢仍看日本政策
日本9月不含生鮮食品的消費者物價年增2.1%，高於8月的1.7%，但相較美歐仍屬溫和，也增添日元的相對吸引力。
瑞穗銀行市場經濟學家Kyugo Hasegawa指出，法國財政問題也提振瑞士法郎，但市場擔心瑞士央行可能出手限制法郎升值，部分避險資金因此可能轉向日元。
不過，他強調，日元能否延續漲勢，最終仍取決於日本國內財政與貨幣政策走向。
paras_en: Gold slipped below $4,000 an ounce on Friday (the 23rd), the yen rallied to a key technical level, and U.S. Treasuries attracted buying, indicating rising global risk‑off sentiment, yet investors are becoming selective about safe‑haven assets.
French fiscal concerns, AI investment financing pressure and Middle‑East tensions intertwine, and as investors lower risk exposure, the performance of traditional safe‑haven assets diverges markedly.

The market this week faced multiple pressures, including doubts over European sovereign debt sparked by France’s budget deficit, questions about whether AI capital spending can keep receiving financing, and Middle‑East geopolitical risk. The U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield fell below 5% again on Thursday, the first time in a month, reflecting a flow into U.S. bonds.
Gold, however, moved opposite to the trend, dropping on Friday to as low as $3,986.50 an ounce, a three‑month low, with a cumulative weekly decline of 4%.

Berenberg analysts note that gold’s weakness in a risk‑off environment is a noteworthy divergence. Normally, falling Treasury yields support non‑yielding gold, but this week investors bought Treasuries while continuously selling gold. The last time gold was this weak when bond yields fell sharply dates back to the most severe phase of the 2008 financial crisis in December 2008.
Speculative retreat and subdued rate expectations weigh on gold prices.

Berenberg says gold’s weakness is linked to its role as a speculative asset over the past year. A speculative boom pushed gold above $5,400 in January, a historic high, but as traders exited, the price has fallen more than one‑fifth from that peak.

CME chief economist Erik Norland says the biggest driver of this year’s precious‑metal price decline is the market’s shift from expectations of rate cuts to rate hikes. Yet, with fiscal deficits eroding bond‑market confidence, rising inflation, geopolitical risk and central banks continuing to buy gold, prices remain well above early‑2025 levels.

World Gold Council data show central‑bank gold purchases in September rose to the highest monthly level since November 2024. Senior market strategist John Reade points out that high rates reduce gold’s investment appeal while high energy prices weaken consumers’ ability to buy gold. With a lack of hedging demand this year, fundamental factors are more evident.
$4,000 breach – watch ETF selling pressure
Several fund managers remain cautiously optimistic about gold, expecting a price rebound, but technical and funding pressures add uncertainty.
Berenberg warns that gold closing below $4,000 on Friday could trigger further outflows from gold ETFs and technical selling pressure on gold‑related stocks.
Gold‑ETF demand weakened in the first half of the year, rebounded in Q3 as September sales picked up, and now the price dip creates new pressure on related fund flows.
Yen strengthens – Goldman names it top hedging tool

Compared with gold, the yen was the main beneficiary of this week’s safe‑haven trading. French debt worries pushed the yen up to a one‑year high of 175.20 per euro, while the dollar fell to 156.08 per yen, a five‑week low.

Goldman FICC analyst Chryssafis lists the yen as the preferred hedge in a scenario of an AI‑bubble burst. The dollar/yen pair has broken below multiple support levels around 157.50 and the 50‑day moving average.

Goldman believes declining attractiveness of dollar assets and capital returning to Japan help lift the yen. Its long‑term fair‑value model shows the yen is about 40% undervalued versus the dollar, making it the cheapest currency among those tracked.
Further upside depends on Japanese policy
Japan’s core CPI (excluding fresh food) rose 2.1% YoY in September, up from 1.7% in August, still moderate compared with the U.S. and Europe, adding to the yen’s relative appeal.

Mizuho economist Kyugo Hasegawa notes that French fiscal issues also buoy the Swiss franc, but markets worry the Swiss central bank may intervene to curb franc gains, potentially shifting some safe‑haven flows to the yen.
He stresses, however, that whether the yen can sustain its rally ultimately hinges on Japan’s domestic fiscal and monetary policy trajectory.

items.title: 誤會一場 潤泰新：「松濤苑」5樓戶坪價實爲254萬元優於上筆成交
items.title_en: A Misunderstanding: Runtaixin Says the 5th‑Floor Unit at Songtao Garden Actually Sold at NT$2.54 million per Ping, Higher Than the Previous Deal
paras: 原依實價登錄資料顯示，豪宅「松濤苑」今年6月以總價4億6180萬元無貸款交易，成交原潤泰新(9945-TW)的5樓戶，連6個車位共258.22坪，換算單價244.33萬元，但潤泰新指出，此一登錄資料因作業疏失，這筆松濤苑實價登錄漏列車位價1820萬元，因此實際成交價爲4.8億元，坪價爲254萬元且優於上筆交易的250萬元。
潤泰新並強調，目前潤泰新地政部門預計於27日將就此一交易的實價登錄資料實價向地政局申請資料更正。
潤泰新指出， 「松濤苑」5樓戶，由客戶向潤泰新買下，連同6個車位共達258.22坪，扣除車位後的實際銷售每坪單價為254萬元，比前一次成交還高。
如潤泰新對「松濤苑」5樓戶交易實價登錄交易申報完成更正，豪宅社區「松濤苑」完工13年以來的最新成交價格站穩250萬元之上。
台北市中正區植物園景觀豪宅「松濤苑」只興建12樓，總戶數僅20 戶，目前屋齡13年多，依實價登錄交易14筆的資料顯示， 2015年8月，「松濤苑」6樓戶曾創下每坪270.6萬元的社區每坪最高成交單價。
paras_en: According to the original real‑price registration data, the luxury residence "Songtao Garden" was reported to have been sold in June of this year for a total price of NT$461.8 million without a loan, involving Runtaixin's (9945‑TW) 5th‑floor unit together with six parking spaces covering a total of 258.22 ping, which would imply a unit price of NT$2.4433 million per ping. Runtaixin, however, pointed out that the registration omitted the value of the parking spaces—NT$18.2 million—due to a clerical error, so the actual transaction price was NT$480 million, yielding a per‑ping price of NT$2.54 million, which is higher than the previous transaction price of NT$2.5 million.
Runtaixin emphasized that its land‑administration department plans to submit a request to the Land Administration Bureau on the 27th to correct the real‑price registration data for this transaction.

Runtaixin explained that the 5th‑floor unit at "Songtao Garden" was purchased by a client from Runtaixin, including six parking spaces for a total of 258.22 ping; after excluding the parking spaces, the actual sale price per ping is NT$2.54 million, which is higher than the previous deal.

If Runtaixin completes the correction of the real‑price registration for the 5th‑floor unit transaction, the latest sale price of the "Songtao Garden" luxury community—now 13 years since completion—will remain above NT$2.5 million per ping.

The "Songtao Garden" luxury residence in Taipei's Zhongzheng District, adjacent to the Botanical Garden, consists of only 12 floors and 20 units in total. The building is a little over 13 years old, and according to 14 recorded transactions, the highest per‑ping price in the community was set in August 2015 when a 6th‑floor unit sold for NT$2.706 million per ping.

items.title: 美期中選舉前大盤加速趕底 8檔台股搶手型ETF戰力猛
items.title_en: U.S. Midterm Election Looms as Taiwan Market Accelerates Bottom‑Finding; Six Semiconductor‑Focused ETFs Among the Hottest Picks
paras: 10 月來外資連續賣超台股，大盤跌得鼻青臉腫，不過，台股ETF中，仍有不少檔績效搶眼，規模成長異軍突起，根據CMoney統計，截至2026/10/22為止，近1年大盤上漲約66.5%，績效表現最好的台股ETF中，出現6檔半導體型、1檔科技型、1檔主動型脫穎而出，不論規模、績效都維持正成長。法人表示，美國期中選舉前，台股行情轉趨震盪，大盤加速趕底過程中，只要績效持續衝高、規模不斷增加，都表示這類ETF獲投資人青睞，是台股搶手型ETF。
根據CMoney統計至10/22止，近1年台股主、被動ETF績效最好的前十強名單中，計有8檔ETF不論績效、規模都雙雙正成長，帶動ETF出現績效好、買氣旺的搶手表現，績效方面，台新臺灣IC設計(00947-TW)上漲122.31%，表現最好，而兆豐台灣晶圓製造(00913-TW)、野村臺灣新科技50(00935-TW)分別上漲120.25%、108.55%，緊追在後。
至於主動式台股ETF，則有主動統一台股增長ETF(00981A-TW)唯一進榜；排名第5到10名，全數由半導體ETF擔綱，依序為中信00891、富邦00892、台新00904、群益00927等，財富管理專家分析，今年半導體類股表現強勢，不少重量級個股從年初迄今一路表現強勢，是台股多頭的領頭羊，帶動半導體ETF績效也跟著水漲船高。
規模方面，唯一進榜的主動統一台股增長ETF(00981A-TW)，近1年規模成長1,231.56%，增幅強壓其他台股被動ETF，表現亦一枝獨秀；而其他半導體ETF如群益00927、台新00947、中信00891，台新00904四檔，規模也都有約1至5倍不等的增幅。

台新00904、00947兩檔ETF經理人黃鈺民表示，台積電10月法說，已再次確認全球半導體的晶片需求強勁，獲利能見度拉高，AI需求也將持續為半導體供應鏈帶來新訂單，從最新8月台灣外銷訂單首度突破千億美元，年增逾7成來看，台灣AI、半導體供應鏈接單能力強，在企業營運業績展望亮麗下，預估2027年台灣半導體企業憑藉先進製程技術、成熟供應鏈生態系及長期客戶夥伴深厚關係，競爭護城河仍保持完整，全球半導體供應鏈的核心地位短期內難以被取代。
他建議投資人趁現在台股盤勢不穩，可分批持有台灣半導體產業型ETF或聚焦AI擴散行情帶旺IC設計、記憶體為核心的IC設計產業ETF，掌握全球AI紅利引爆、行情擴散下的科技股新牛勢。

paras_en: In October, foreign investors have been net sellers of Taiwanese stocks, leaving the market bruised, yet several Taiwan‑stock ETFs have posted eye‑catching performance and rapid asset growth. According to CMoney data up to 2026‑10‑22, the broader market rose about 66.5% over the past year, and the best‑performing ETFs include six semiconductor‑focused, one technology‑focused and one active‑managed fund, all showing positive growth in both scale and returns. Analysts say that ahead of the U.S. midterm elections the Taiwan market is becoming more volatile, and as the index races toward a bottom, ETFs that keep delivering strong returns and expanding assets are clearly favored by investors, making them the most sought‑after Taiwan ETFs.

Based on CMoney’s ranking as of 10/22, eight of the top‑ten performing Taiwan ETFs—both active and passive—have seen simultaneous growth in returns and assets, driving a hot‑buyer market. In terms of performance, Taishin Taiwan IC Design (00947‑TW) led with a 122.31% gain, followed by Mega Financial Taiwan Wafer Manufacturing (00913‑TW) up 120.25% and Nomura Taiwan New Technology 50 (00935‑TW) up 108.55%.

Among active Taiwan ETFs, only the Active Uni‑Taiwan Growth ETF (00981A‑TW) made the list. Positions five through ten were all occupied by semiconductor ETFs: CTBC 00891, Fubon 00892, Taishin 00904 and Yuanta 00927, in that order. Wealth‑management experts note that semiconductor stocks have been strong this year, with many heavyweight names delivering robust performance since the start of the year, leading the market’s bullish trend and lifting semiconductor‑ETF returns along with it.

In terms of scale, the sole active entrant, Uni‑Taiwan Growth ETF (00981A‑TW), grew its assets by 1,231.56% over the past year, outpacing all other passive Taiwan ETFs and standing out uniquely. The other semiconductor ETFs—Yuanta 00927, Taishin 00947, CTBC 00891 and Taishin 00904—also posted asset increases ranging roughly from one‑ to five‑fold.

ETF managers Huang Yu‑min of Taishin 00904 and 00947 said TSMC’s October earnings call reaffirmed strong global chip demand and raised profit visibility, with AI driving new orders throughout the semiconductor supply chain. Taiwan’s August export orders broke the US$100 billion mark for the first time, up more than 70% year‑over‑year, underscoring the island’s AI and semiconductor order‑taking strength. Looking ahead to 2027, they expect Taiwanese semiconductor firms to maintain a solid competitive moat thanks to advanced process technology, a mature supply‑chain ecosystem and deep long‑term customer relationships, keeping Taiwan at the core of the global semiconductor supply chain in the near term.

He advises investors to take advantage of the current market volatility by gradually building positions in Taiwan semiconductor‑industry ETFs or ETFs focused on AI‑driven IC design and memory sectors, to capture the new tech‑stock rally sparked by global AI dividends and market diffusion.

items.title: 胡連斥2.5億元收購LA PUNTA 8成股權 跨足高端重機與頂級超跑供應鏈
items.title_en: Hu Lian Announces NT$250 Million Purchase of 80% Stake in LA PUNTA, Expanding into High-End Motorcycle and Supercar Supply Chains
paras: 連接器廠胡連(6279-TW)今(24)日公告，旗下義大利子公司Hu Lane Associate Europe S.r.l.已簽署股權買賣合約，將以688萬歐元(約新台幣2.5億元)收購義大利公司LA PUNTA S.R.L. 80%股權，跨足高端重機與頂級超跑供應鏈，交易預計於明年1月底完成。
胡連表示，本次收購主要為進行歐洲產業垂直與橫向整合，以滿足集團未來營運成長需求，透過收購不僅將跨足高端重機與頂級超跑供應鏈，還可分散單一區域市場風險、提升國際市場營收比重及前端研發與客訴回應速度，推動技術升級及多元產業延伸。
胡連表示，此次收購金額688萬歐元，其中企業價值為576萬歐元，另包含淨負債及營運資金112萬歐元，本次交易以現金為對價，資金來源為自有資金及銀行借款，收購完成後，將持續經營標的公司既有業務，並與現任經營團隊合作，整合集團資源，拓展國際市場及客戶基礎。
交易價格方面，胡連表示，公司委託國富浩華聯合會計師事務所評估，採用市場法中的可類比公司法及收益法中的現金流量折現法，分別賦予50%權重。市場法篩選7家全球公開發行的可類比公司，以本益比第一四分位數12.42倍作為評價依據；收益法則依標的公司未來預估現金流量進行折現。
經綜合評估，標的公司80%股權對應的企業價值合理區間為552.7萬至626.1萬歐元(未含淨負債及營運資金部位)，本次交易採用的企業價值576萬歐元落在上述合理區間內，因此，會計師認為交易價格尚屬合理。
paras_en: Connector maker Hu Lian (6279‑TW) announced today that its Italian subsidiary Hu Lane Associate Europe S.r.l. has signed a share purchase agreement to acquire an 80% stake in Italy’s LA PUNTA S.R.L. for €6.88 million (approximately NT$250 million). The deal, which will bring the company into the high‑end motorcycle and top‑tier supercar supply chain, is expected to close by the end of January next year.

Hu Lian said the acquisition is aimed at achieving vertical and horizontal integration of its European operations to meet future growth needs. By entering the high‑end motorcycle and supercar supply chain, the group can diversify regional market risk, increase the share of international revenue, and improve front‑end R&D and customer‑complaint response speed, thereby driving technology upgrades and diversification into new industries.

The purchase price of €6.88 million comprises an enterprise value of €5.76 million plus net debt and working capital of €1.12 million. The transaction will be paid in cash, funded by the company’s own resources and bank loans. After closing, Hu Lian will continue to operate the target’s existing business, cooperate with the current management team, integrate group resources, and expand its international market and customer base.

Regarding valuation, Hu Lian engaged Guo Fu Hao Hua United CPA Firm, which applied a 50/50 weighting of the market‑approach comparable‑company method and the income‑approach discounted cash‑flow method. The market approach screened seven publicly listed global peers and used the first‑quartile P/E multiple of 12.42× as the benchmark; the income approach discounted the target’s projected future cash flows.

Based on the combined assessment, the reasonable range for the enterprise value of the 80% stake is €5.527 million to €6.261 million (excluding net debt and working capital). The €5.76 million enterprise value used in this transaction falls within that range, so the accountants consider the purchase price to be reasonable.

paras_en: AI accelerator compute demand is exploding, and next‑generation chips require much larger substrate area and more layers, driving a sharp rise in demand for high‑end ABF substrates. With longer equipment lead times and much tougher processes, the high‑end supply‑demand gap is expected to widen through 2028. Global tech giants have already launched long‑term contracts and prepaid orders to lock in supply, signalling that pricing power has officially shifted from buyers to suppliers.
"Size and layer count surge non‑linearly, equivalent processing area climbs, testing process yield,"

In advanced packaging architectures, AI chips integrate more compute cores and high‑bandwidth memory (HBM), causing the photomask size to expand from 1× in early generations to 3×, even over 9×. Substrate specifications have likewise jumped from the former 55 × 55 mm to 110 × 110 mm and to complex stacks of 26 layers or more. This drives a non‑linear explosion in equivalent processing area. Large area and high layer counts not only consume far more production capacity, they also magnify warpage caused by differences in coefficient of thermal expansion (CTE) and make line‑up alignment far more difficult. Manufacturers that can achieve high‑volume production and yield control will command a premium for their technology.
"Glass and ceramic cores poised to take off, new materials force a technological shift,"

To overcome the physical warpage and thermal limits of traditional organic substrates at ultra‑large sizes, glass‑core substrates and ceramic intermediate layers have become the key breakthrough for next‑generation high‑end packaging. Although the new architectures initially face challenges in processing precision and yield maturity, major Taiwanese and Japanese firms have already begun early‑stage technology positioning. By introducing ultra‑low‑CTE materials, automated routing and design‑for‑manufacturability (DFM) rules, the supply chain is accelerating the transition from traditional organic cores to emerging inorganic materials. In the medium‑to‑long term this will unlock another wave of value‑creation from material upgrades in the substrate industry.

items.title_en: Travel Industry Boosts Online Travel Fair Sales; Discounts on These Routes and Airfares
paras: 全台最大旅展─2026 ITF台灣國際旅展將於11月6日至11月9日登場，不少大型觀光和航空業者已先行開跑線上旅展，適逢颱風和連假，本周末先爆出一波旅遊買氣，包括機票、主題行程買氣均熱。
雄獅(2731-TW)表示，今年冬季旅遊訂單人數已較去年成長3成，主要受惠於機票價格趨穩，且有超過6成的既有會員回流購買，旅客出遊相較「旅行目的地」更重「旅行目的」，赴日旅客逾7成以「溫泉、美食、雪國」為冬遊三大主題。
雄獅進一步觀察，短線旅客也偏好拉長天數慢遊，日本6天以上長天數團體人數成長4成，東南亞則轉向五星飯店與渡假村等重住宿的度假型態，而長線則因國際轉機航班與航網逐步恢復、票價趨穩，使歐洲訂單成長達6成，不少旅客半年前就提前卡位，以北歐極光、雪梨跨年最熱銷。
雄獅看好冬季與春節買氣，預估此波線上旅展業績年增幅將達雙位數。
而長榮航(2618-TW)指出，線上旅展已開跑，精選航線82折起(均未稅)，其中，瞄準短期快閃旅客需求，推出桃園-香港最低只要3280元起、桃園-首爾6059元起、桃園-沖繩6640元起，而旅客最愛的日本航線，松山-羽田最低11305元起；而長程旅行中，桃園-印度德里只要13940元起、桃園-布里斯本15334元起、桃園-維也納22950元起，以及桃園-舊金山27000元起(含稅)。

paras_en: The largest travel fair in Taiwan—the 2026 ITF Taiwan International Travel Expo—will be held from November 6 to November 9. Many major tourism and airline companies have already launched online travel fairs. With a typhoon and a long weekend, a wave of travel buying surged this weekend, covering both airfare and themed tour packages.

Lion Travel (2731‑TW) said winter‑season travel orders are up 30% year‑over‑year, helped by stabilising ticket prices and a return of more than 60% of existing members. Travelers now focus more on the purpose of the trip than the destination, with over 70% of Japan‑bound tourists choosing hot springs, food and snow‑country as the three main winter themes.

Lion Travel further observed that short‑haul travelers prefer longer stays. Groups staying six days or more in Japan grew 40%, while Southeast‑Asia travelers shifted toward five‑star hotels and resort‑style vacations. Long‑haul demand rose as international connections and route networks recover and fares stabilise, with European orders up 60%; many booked six months ahead, especially for Northern‑Europe aurora tours and Sydney New Year’s trips.
Lion Travel is optimistic about winter and Chinese‑New‑Year demand, forecasting double‑digit year‑over‑year growth for this round of online travel‑fair sales.

EVA Air (2618‑TW) noted the online fair is underway, offering selected routes at 18% off (pre‑tax). Targeting short‑term flash travelers, it offers Taoyuan‑Hong Kong from NT$3,280, Taoyuan‑Seoul from NT$6,059, Taoyuan‑Okinawa from NT$6,640, and the most popular Japan route, Songshan‑Haneda from NT$11,305. For longer trips, Taoyuan‑Delhi starts at NT$13,940, Taoyuan‑Brisbane at NT$15,334, Taoyuan‑Vienna at NT$22,950, and Taoyuan‑San Francisco at NT$27,000 (tax included).
At the same time, EVA Air will create a lavish physical exhibition themed “Indian Palace” to celebrate the upcoming launch of the Taoyuan‑Delhi route on December 1.

China Airlines (2610‑TW) said the travel fair this year highlights popular routes at a minimum of 24% off (pre‑tax), including Taipei‑Brisbane from NT$15,957, Taipei‑Sydney from NT$16,188, and Taipei‑Melbourne and Taipei‑Auckland both at NT$18,000. Taipei‑Cebu starts at NT$3,354 and Taipei‑Busan at NT$5,994.

items.title: 006208擬分割一拆八！12/18開受益人會議 入手一張只要3萬元
items.title_en: Fubon Taiwan 50 ETF (006208) Plans 1‑for‑8 Split; Beneficiary Meeting on Dec 18, One Unit Costs Only NT$30,000
paras: 台股 ETF 人氣王之一－富邦台 50 ETF(006208-TW)終於走上分割之路，富邦投信將於12月18日以書面方式召開受益人會議，表決是否進行基金分割，初估分割倍數為8倍，藉此降低單位交易價格與投資門檻，屆時買進一張只要 3 萬元，讓小資族更容易入手。若議案順利通過，實際分割倍數將依會議通過當日的基金淨值計算。
富邦投信表示，006208追蹤臺灣50指數，持有台股市值最大的50家上市公司。該基金成立於2012年，初次發行價格為30元，隨台股長期走高，截至2026年10月6日，每單位淨值已達266.74元，市價約265.9元，均為發行價的近9倍，投資門檻也隨之提高，因此規劃透過分割，讓交易價格回到投資人較熟悉的區間，並維持市場流動性。
本次分割倍數並非固定8倍，而是依會議通過當日淨值，以回到30元以上的最大整數倍計算。例如，淨值介於240至269.99元，分割倍數為8倍；若介於270至299.99元，則為9倍。若以8倍分割為例，原持有1單位將調整為8單位，單位淨值則相應降低，基金總價值不會因分割而改變。
投資人可自11月26日起留意開會通知，並選擇書面投票，或透過「集保e手掌握」及各大證券下單App進入集保電子投票平台表決。電子投票期間為11月27日至12月15日，受益憑證過戶則自11月19日至12月18日停止辦理。分割案須有代表已發行受益權單位總數過半數的受益人出席，並經出席者表決權過半數同意，才能通過。
006208人氣與規模同步攀升，截至10月8日受益人數已達71.2萬人；基金規模也從2025年底約2897.8億元，增至今年10月6日的4963億元，今年增加逾2000億元、成長超過七成，距離5000億元大關僅一步之遙。值得注意的是，基金規模突破5000億元後，超過該門檻部分適用的經理費率將降至0.08%。若分割案順利過關，006208可望降低投資人進場門檻，進一步提升交易便利性。

paras_en: One of Taiwan's most popular stock ETFs, the Fubon Taiwan 50 ETF (006208‑TW), is finally moving toward a split. Fubon Asset Management will hold a written beneficiary meeting on December 18 to vote on whether to split the fund, initially estimating an 8‑for‑1 split to lower the unit price and entry threshold. After the split, a single unit could be bought for just NT$30,000, making it easier for retail investors. If the proposal passes, the exact split ratio will be calculated based on the fund's net asset value on the meeting day.

Fubon Asset Management says that 006208 tracks the Taiwan 50 Index, holding the 50 largest listed Taiwanese companies by market cap. The fund was launched in 2012 with an initial price of NT$30 per unit. As the Taiwan market has risen over the long term, the net asset value per unit reached NT$266.74 as of October 6, 2026, with a market price around NT$265.9—nearly nine times the issue price—raising the investment threshold. The split is intended to bring the trading price back to a range familiar to investors while preserving market liquidity.

The split ratio is not fixed at eight; it will be the largest integer multiple that brings the post‑split price back above NT$30, based on the NAV on the meeting day. For example, if the NAV is between NT$240 and NT$269.99, the split will be 8‑for‑1; if it is between NT$270 and NT$299.99, it will be 9‑for‑1. Using an 8‑for‑1 split as an example, one original unit would become eight units, with the unit NAV proportionally reduced, leaving the fund’s total value unchanged.

Investors can start watching for the meeting notice from November 26 and vote in writing, or use the “CDRC e‑Hand” platform and major brokerage apps to access the electronic voting system. The electronic voting period runs from November 27 to December 15, and the transfer of beneficiary certificates is suspended from November 19 to December 18. The split proposal requires attendance by beneficiaries representing more than half of the issued units and approval by a majority of the voting rights present.

The popularity and size of 006208 have both risen. As of October 8, the fund has 712,000 beneficiaries, and its assets under management grew from about NT$289.78 billion at the end of 2025 to NT$496.3 billion on October 6 this year—an increase of over NT$200 billion and more than 70% growth, putting it just shy of the NT$500 billion milestone. Notably, once assets exceed NT$500 billion, the management fee on the excess portion drops to 0.08%. If the split is approved, 006208 could lower entry barriers and further improve trading convenience.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉防詐業務需求強勁 GOGOLOOK股價周漲2成
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Strong Demand for Anti-Fraud Services, GOGOLOOK Shares Jump 20% This Week
paras: 信任科技服務商GOGOLOOK(6902-TW)受惠於海外市場擴張與多元產品線布局，9月營收續創單月新高紀錄，由於積極拓展防詐事業和金融科技，屬剛性需求，股價較未受大盤明顯波動的衝擊，本周股價大漲20%，周線連2紅，續戰歷史前高。
GOGOLOOK前三季合併營收3.36億元，年增25.7%，創單季新高，今年前三季營收9.48 億元，年增 26.9%，也創同期新高，GOGOLOOK樂觀看待，隨著營運規模突破關鍵門檻，獲利將隨營收規模同步放大，且下半年獲利將優於上半年。
GOGOLOOK主要發展消費者防詐、企業端防詐和金融科技服務等三大業務，其中，隨著海內外企業與政府機構積極提升資安防護能，GOGOLOOK防詐情資解決方案(ASI)在日本與合作夥伴推廣順利，將持續拓展更多海外市場。
GOGOLOOK 強調，持續投入 AI 防詐技術創新，主要鎖定東南亞7億人口市場，並將同步布局歐美地區，與國際組織、各國政府和大型企業合作。
而在金融科技服務方面，GOGOLOOK旗下JUJI 招財麻吉在風險控管、營收規模等營運表現持續優於內部預期，占整體營收比重可望上看30%。
在消費者防詐端，隨著詐騙手法日新月異，GOGOLOOK因應消費者的需求，旗下Whoscall持續迭代產品功能，近日開啟「自訂來電者名稱」功能，讓陌生來電不再陌生。
paras_en: Trust technology provider GOGOLOOK (6902-TW) benefited from overseas market expansion and a diversified product lineup, with September revenue setting a new monthly record. Driven by aggressive growth in its anti‑fraud business and fintech—both considered rigid demand—the stock was less affected by broader market volatility and surged 20% this week, posting two consecutive weekly gains and pushing toward a historic high.

GOGOLOOK reported combined revenue of NT$3.36 billion for the first three quarters, up 25.7% year‑over‑year and a new quarterly peak. Total revenue for the first three quarters reached NT$9.48 billion, up 26.9% YoY, also a record for the period. The company is optimistic that as its operating scale crosses key thresholds, profit will grow proportionally with revenue, and that second‑half earnings will surpass the first half.

GOGOLOOK’s core businesses are consumer anti‑fraud, enterprise anti‑fraud, and fintech services. With domestic and foreign enterprises and government agencies actively strengthening cybersecurity, GOGOLOOK’s anti‑fraud intelligence solution (ASI) is being successfully promoted in Japan with partners and will continue to expand into more overseas markets.

The company emphasizes ongoing investment in AI‑driven anti‑fraud technology, targeting the 700‑million‑person Southeast Asian market while simultaneously building a presence in Europe and the United States, collaborating with international organizations, governments and large corporations.

In fintech, GOGOLOOK’s subsidiary JUJI Zhaocai Maji has consistently outperformed internal expectations in risk control and revenue growth, and its contribution to total revenue could rise to about 30%.

On the consumer anti‑fraud front, as scam tactics evolve rapidly, GOGOLOOK responds to user needs through its Whoscall app, which continuously adds new features. Recently it launched a “custom caller name” function, making unknown calls recognizable.

items.title: 載板三雄誰最強？杜金龍點名ABF「這檔首選」獲利大調高！外資目標價曝光 還有這檔短多快閃操作！
paras: 台灣電路板產業年度盛事「TPCA 台灣電路板展」日前盛大開展，高階 AI 伺服器、高速運算對高階板材與高密度散熱的需求，再次成為市場焦點。在眾多零組件中，最吸金的莫過於沉寂已久的 ABF 載板族群。
隨著各大外資法人陸續調高評等，欣興(3037-TW)、南電(8046-TW)、景碩(3189-TW)這「載板三雄」全面轉強。股民們最關心的問題來了：如果資金有限只能買一檔，到底誰才是真正的真命天子？
台股老先覺杜金龍在《股民想知道》節目中給出肯定答案：「載板是我今年到處演講都強調、明年到後年整個 AI 裡最值得投資的類股！而這三檔裡面，我的首選絕對是 3037 的欣興！」
此外，針對展場上爆紅的輝達新材料概念股，杜金龍更揭露了主力「私募作價」的背後內幕，傳授一套精準的「短多快閃操作法」。

一、載板三雄大直球對決！杜金龍為什麼獨挑「欣興」？
在 ABF 載板三雄中，各有各的擁護者：
南電（8046）： 獲利能力最強，預估 EPS 高達 70 幾元，外資目標價甚至喊到 2,000 元以上。
景碩（3189）： 先前基期偏低，近期補漲力道猛烈，更有法人靠它繳出數倍的驚人報酬。
但杜金龍為何堅定首選欣興？他點出三大不可替代的關鍵：
大客戶全在欣興手上：欣興擁有極高的研發能量，技術遙遙領先，目前已成功布局最新 1.6T 高速光模組 PCB，通吃全球頂尖晶片龍頭訂單，產業護城河深厚。
走勢穩健「大漲小回」：相較於其他個股的暴起暴落，欣興的籌碼與多頭格局更具延續性，每波都是以大漲、小幅回檔整理的階梯式向上攻堅。
獲利預估大幅三級跳：杜金龍出示研究數據指出，法人原先預估欣興到 2028 年的 EPS 只有 50 元左右，但最新研究報告已全面大幅調升至「71 元以上」！

欣興目標價怎麼算？
杜金龍表示，最簡單的評價方式就是用「EPS × 本益比」：
71 元（EPS）× 20 倍本益比 ＝ 1,420 元
目前欣興股價已站穩千元之上，外資更是陸續調高目標價。杜金龍坦言，先前欣興因洗產地疑慮跌到 600 多元，後來拉回 940 元、1,000 元附近他都想買，「這檔股票真的是每次沒買它就噴上去！長線來看，只要月營收持續增加、法人持續調高 EPS，每一次拉回季線都是絕佳的存股上車點。」

二、鑽針消耗量激增！尖點（8021）有題材、做價差
除了載板本體，展場上另一個大亮點是「高階板材加工難度暴增」，鑽孔難度增加導致鑽針損耗率大增，鑽針大廠**尖點（8021）**因此受到關注。
尖點上半年 EPS 達 3.2 元，杜金龍以簡易年化估算，全年有望上看 6 元以上，較過去兩年大幅成長。但他提醒投資人：
(圖片來源:優分析產業數據庫)
尖點月 K 線的慣性是**「有利多就噴一段，隨後回檔盤整」**。
由於市場沒有長期的權威獲利模型做定錨，這檔股票適合在展覽題材點火、股價低檔轉折時**「快速來回做區間價差」**，不建議長線死抱。

三、短多快閃預警！輝達 PTFE 新材料爆紅，小心台郡「私募」陷阱！
除了載板，輝達日前在 OCP 全球峰會上展出 NVLink 交換器，宣布導入全新材料 PTFE（鐵氟龍），引爆台廠供應鏈包括**台郡（6269）、台虹（8039）**連續拉出數根漲停，連杜金龍的太太都忍不住掛漲停板追買。
但老先覺定睛一看，立刻看出其中的盤面玄機！
杜金龍指出，台郡雖然轉虧為盈（去年賠 6 元、今年賺 2 元、後年估 3 元），但這波噴出背後有一個不能說的祕密——台郡即將發行 3.2 億元、約佔 10% 的「私募現增案」！
「只要看到發行私募或可轉債，承銷券商的操作 SOP 大家一定要懂！」杜金龍以過去在大華證券承銷部龍頭的經驗直言：
定價前拉抬： 為了把私募或轉換價格拉高，主力與特定買盤會在定價前強勢拉抬股價。
定價後出貨： 一旦特定目標達成、定價宣布，這群特定的「護盤售後服務」就會獲利收案，股價往往應聲倒地（如先前的緯創定在 180 幾元、聯電定在 140 幾元，碰完就下殺）。

杜金龍親授「短多快閃退場訊號」：


觀察爆大量長黑日： 台郡連續漲停後已爆出歷史大量、出現開高走低的劇烈換手震盪。
逃命關鍵點： 只要盤中跌破「爆大量當天」的最低價，代表短線題材已透支、主力可能已經落跑，投資人務必當機立斷、先跑為上！ 至於台虹也是純題材發酵，同樣依循爆量低點作為嚴格的停利停損依據。

結語：核心重兵押欣興，短線題材快狠準！
總結 PCB 族群的操作全攻略，杜金龍建議投資人採取**「雙軌並行」**策略：
長線核心抱大波段： 重兵鎖定「欣興（3037）」，享受 EPS 上修至 71 元的長線大紅利，每次大盤拉回皆可逢低布局，抱到 2028 年 AI 巔峰期。
短線題材快進快出： 針對尖點、台郡、台虹等新題材股，認清其短多與私募作價的本質，有賺就跑，嚴守爆量低點停利，才能在題材狂潮中既賺到投機財，又全身而退！
